import numpy as np, math

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    a=np.array(g)
    cnt=np.bincount(a.ravel()); bg=int(cnt.argmax())
    seen=np.zeros_like(a,bool); objs=[]
    for y in range(H):

            c=int(a[y,x]); st=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=True; cl=[]
            while st:
                cy,cx=st.pop(); cl.append((cy,cx))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny,nx] and a[ny,nx]==c:
                        seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
            objs.append((c,cl))
    def shape(cl):
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cl))
    def canon(cl):
        ys=[y for y,x in cl]; xs=[x for y,x in cl]
        pts=[(y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cl]
        best=[]
        for s in range(8):
            q=[(x,y) if s&1 else (y,x) for y,x in pts]
            if s&2: q=[(p[0],-p[1]) for p in q]
            if s&4: q=[(-p[0],p[1]) for p in q]
            a1,b1=zip(*q); a1=min(a1); b1=min(b1)
            best.append(tuple(sorted((p[0]-a1,p[1]-b1) for p in q)))
        return min(best)
    cc=Counter(c for c,cl in objs)
    markers=[(c,cl) for c,cl in objs if cc[c]==1]
    if not markers: return [list(r) for r in g]

    # pairs where one member touches marker (8-adjacency), prefer largest shape
